title: The HVIP+ Community Model
official: The HVIP+ Community Model: A Community Violence Prevention Program in a Southern State
summary: The present study will use an optimization randomized control trial design to test the preliminary efficacy of a Hospital-based Violence Intervention Program (HVIP) in Central Arkansas.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Be at least 18 years of age or older
* Currently live in Central Arkansas
* Currently being treated for a penetrating gun assault injury at a local hospital

Exclusion Criteria:

Participants must not:

* Report any medical problems that would limit their ability to express thoughts and answer questions (i.e. active intoxication, developmental delays, dementia, psychosis, etc.)
* Be currently under arrest or in police custody
